Sable Outpost (sector 1) is redrawn as a named place: the landing airlock, a U-shaped decon passage, the bunk room and mess hall off it, and the comms room where the Sentinel guards the lift, which stands in a machinery frame. The spawn, the airlock door ahead of it, the Sentinel, the exit door and the lift keep their cells, so every pose names the same place; the zig-zag door became the mess hatch (tour captures renamed). Only the world view changes, apart from the helmet blink landing on other captures because update timing moved; every frame check passes.
